preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The first element of the arithmetic progression A is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The common difference between successive members of A is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The upper limit for the index i is between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.
The lower and upper limits for the index i are within the valid range and the lower limit is less than or equal to the upper limit.

postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a single integer representing the sum of F(A_i) for L ≤ i ≤ R.
